verdict.rationale: Microsoft documents a clear backup/restore path (enable Cloud Backup on Android or iCloud on iOS, then sign in on a new device to restore accounts) per docs-9, docs-13, docs-19. However, hands-on community reports concretely contradict reliability of this recovery: one user reports an app update wiped all account data and locked them out of accounts (comm-1), and another confirms a known, unfixed bug causing similar account-add/restore issues (comm-3). Missing for 10: independent verification that cloud backup restores reliably across devices, and no acknowledgment/fix from Microsoft for the reported data-loss bug.
